options.content:
**Ambiente demonstrativo — dados inteiramente fictícios.**

API e CSV aparecem juntos. Serviço ativo é situação contratual. Online/offline exige telemetria recente; sem coletor os painéis mostram **Sem coleta**. As variáveis do Grafana filtram a visualização; não substituem as permissões por empresa da aplicação.

panels.title: Antenas no filtro
panels.description: Inventário atual; não é limitado pelo intervalo de datas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Antenas" FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring}))

SELECT count(*) AS "CNPJ" FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring})) AND kind='CNPJ'

SELECT count(*) AS "CPF" FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring})) AND kind='CPF'

SELECT count(*) AS "Ativos" FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring})) AND service_status='Ativo'

SELECT count(*) AS "Pendentes" FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring})) AND site='Sem obra'

panels.title: Conectividade · online
panels.description: Sem coleta fresca não é contado como offline.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.online IS NOT NULL)=0 THEN NULL ELSE count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.online=true) END AS online FROM reporting.connectivity c JOIN (SELECT * FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring}))) v USING(company_id,source,terminal_id,kit)

panels.title: Conectividade · offline
panels.description: Amostras com mais de cinco minutos viram Sem coleta.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.online IS NOT NULL)=0 THEN NULL ELSE count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.online=false) END AS offline FROM reporting.connectivity c JOIN (SELECT * FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring}))) v USING(company_id,source,terminal_id,kit)

panels.title: Integrações desatualizadas
panels.description: Último sucesso há mais de 30 minutos. O demo não se atualiza sozinho.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Integrações" FROM reporting.integrations WHERE stale AND source IN (SELECT DISTINCT source FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring})))

SELECT site AS "Obra",count(*) AS "Antenas" FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring})) GROUP BY site ORDER BY count(*) DESC,site

SELECT kind AS "Tipo",count(*) AS "Antenas" FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring})) GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind

SELECT company_name AS "Empresa",source AS "Conta",terminals AS "Antenas",service_lines AS "Linhas",last_success AS "Último sucesso",CASE WHEN stale THEN 'Desatualizada' ELSE 'Recente' END AS "Coleta" FROM reporting.integrations WHERE source IN (SELECT DISTINCT source FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring}))) ORDER BY company_name,source

panels.title: Faturado no período · ${currency}
panels.description: Valor das faturas emitidas no período; não comprova pagamento. Uma moeda por vez.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(amount) AS "Valor" FROM reporting.invoices WHERE source IN (SELECT DISTINCT source FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring}))) AND currency IN (${currency:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(invoice_date)

panels.title: Saldo devido API · ${currency}
panels.description: Snapshot atual da conta; não é mensalidade nem soma de faturas. Não é limitado pelo período.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(due_amount) AS "Saldo atual" FROM reporting.balances WHERE source IN (SELECT DISTINCT source FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring}))) AND currency IN (${currency:sqlstring})

panels.title: Previsão mensal manual · BRL
panels.description: Somente valor cadastrado manualmente em BRL. Não representa emissão ou pagamento de fatura.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(monthly) AS "Previsão BRL" FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring})) AND origin<>'API'

panels.title: Latência · coleta futura
panels.description: Nenhum coletor de telemetria está incluído. Sem amostras, o gráfico fica vazio.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.collected_at,$__interval),avg(t.latency_ms) AS "Latência" FROM reporting.telemetry_samples t WHERE t.source IN (SELECT DISTINCT source FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring}))) AND $__timeFilter(t.collected_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Perda de pacotes · coleta futura
panels.description: Nenhum coletor de telemetria está incluído. Sem amostras, o gráfico fica vazio.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.collected_at,$__interval),avg(t.loss_percent) AS "Perda de pacotes" FROM reporting.telemetry_samples t WHERE t.source IN (SELECT DISTINCT source FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring}))) AND $__timeFilter(t.collected_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT v.company_name AS "Empresa",v.kit AS "KIT",v.name AS "Nome",v.site AS "Obra / regional",v.email AS "E-mail",v.kind AS "Titular",v.origin AS "Origem",v.service_status AS "Serviço",CASE c.online WHEN true THEN 'Online' WHEN false THEN 'Offline' ELSE 'Sem coleta' END AS "Conectividade",v.updated_at AS "Última atualização" FROM (SELECT * FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring}))) v LEFT JOIN reporting.connectivity c USING(company_id,source,terminal_id,kit) ORDER BY v.company_name,v.site,v.kit

panels.title: Faturas API · período e moeda selecionados
panels.description: E-mail, obra e titularidade selecionam contas; exibe a fatura inteira, sem rateio por antena.

targets.rawSql: SELECT company_name AS "Empresa",account AS "Conta",invoice_id AS "Fatura",invoice_date AS "Emissão",due_date AS "Vencimento",currency AS "Moeda",amount AS "Valor",due_amount AS "Saldo devido",status AS "Situação" FROM reporting.invoices WHERE source IN (SELECT DISTINCT source FROM reporting.inventory WHERE ('__all__' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR company_id IN (${company:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${kind:sqlstring}) OR kind IN (${kind:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR email IN (${email:sqlstring}) OR ('__empty__' IN (${email:sqlstring}) AND email='')) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:sqlstring}) OR site IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${account:sqlstring}))) AND currency IN (${currency:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(invoice_date) ORDER BY invoice_date DESC,invoice_id

description: Projeto demonstrativo. Cadastros sintéticos. Telemetria futura; situação contratual não comprova conectividade.
